## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title and the commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...); incompatible changes use `feat!:` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Releases and the changelog are generated from them.
- [ ] `poe check` passes (lint, format check, type check, offline tests)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavioural changes. They run offline (fake LLM or the tiny-model fixture); tests that need an optional extra use `pytest.importorskip`
- [ ] Public objects have Google-style docstrings (`Args`, `Returns`, `Raises`, `Example`) and the docs are updated; `poe docs-build` passes
- [ ] No API keys, tokens or personal data in configurations, notebooks or logs
